payload.title: Square Enix is turning slimes into AI chatbots in Dragon Quest X using Google's Gemini
payload.content: Square Enix has announced a partnership with Google to integrate Gemini AI into Dragon Quest X, turning in-game slime characters into AI-powered chatbots capable of holding conversations with players. The feature represents one of the first major deployments of a frontier LLM as an interactive NPC system in a live MMORPG.

signals.signal_label: MMORPG 集成前沿 LLM 作为交互式 NPC 系统
signals.description: Square Enix 与 Google 合作，将 Gemini AI 集成到《勇者斗恶龙 X》中，使史莱姆角色成为能与玩家对话的 AI 聊天机器人。这是前沿 LLM 在大型 MMORPG 中作为交互式 NPC 系统的首次重大部署。
